notes.title: 2024-01-02 Update (1.0.9v)
notes.content:
- Fixing the bug that shows [?] on the rule sheet at the end of the complaint, even though the festival confirmed the booth application conflict
- Fixing bugs that indicate that the rules should be modified even after the festival complaints have ended normally
- Fixing bugs that remain fast even if the first day goes over from time to time
- The UI of the settlement scene has been added, so you can check the future schedule.

notes.title: 2023-12-22 bug fix (1.0.8a v)
notes.content: - Fixed an issue that prevented you from starting the game on a new device.

notes.title: Rollback to 1.0.6v
notes.content: - Roll back the version for a while due to a problem that does not work normally on a device that has never run this World Dong office.

notes.title: Dec/04/2023 Update notes (1.0.8v)
notes.content:
- Frame setting function has been added.
- Improved some of the disaster work UX.
- We have further revised the 'screening' phenomenon of some civil complaints.

notes.title: November 20, 2023 Difficulty patch(1.0.7v)
notes.content:
- We've adjusted the difficulty level of the civil complaint time.
- We have improved visibility when complaints fail.
- Fixed some UI bugs.

notes.title: November 6, 2023: bug fix(1.0.6v)
notes.content:
- Decrease situations that objects getting out like licenses.
- Playguide get intended color.

notes.title: 2023-10-24 Ending/Convenience update (1.0.5v)
notes.content:
- fixed some ending cutscenes : we wanted festival, not funeral.
- fixed some ingame tools.
- made play guide more convenient

notes.title: 2023-10-22 Bug fix: failed entering disaster root(12~14th) (1.0.3v)
notes.content: Fixed an issue where entering the Disaster Route (Day12) worked differently than intended.

notes.title: 2023-10-17 Hotfix about high frame(1.0.2v)
notes.content:
- Temporary, we fixed the frame of our game.
We will add a frame-related option setting as soon as possible.

notes.title: 2023-10-16 Bugfix (1.0.1v)
notes.content: - Bug is fixed that user can't play 19th day.
